title: Reading and writing grades 2–3
audience: a child in grades K–5 working with an adult helper who reads along
purpose: Read multisyllable words fluently, find main ideas and story structure, use text features, and write paragraphs, stories and opinions.

weeks.2: Words with more than one syllable

blocks.deliverable: Decode 20 two-syllable words and sort them by vowel pattern.
Read a passage aloud at a steady pace and state its main idea.
Map a story's events and explain one cause and its effect.
Week 7 check-up; use headings, captions and context clues to answer questions.
Write a paragraph with a topic sentence, three details and an ending.
Write a short story and an opinion piece with reasons.
Finish the project with your grown-up; take the 30-minute final check in week 14.

project: Write and illustrate a short nonfiction booklet about an animal, with headings, a glossary and a labeled picture.
completion: finish the project with a grown-up, take the week 7 check-up and the week 14 final check, then redo any missed questions a week later. Show or tell one big idea from the course in your own words.
